column1: # The public API of ZTronDSP against the specification (WP-901a).
# One line per entry, four columns separated by one tab: module, symbol, where it is listed, note.
#   module   the module that declares the symbol, as Docs/API/<module>.txt names it.
#   symbol   as the digests spell it: a top-level declaration (`DSPEngine`, `ztd_ring_create(_:_:_:)`); a
#            member of the module's own type that §4–§8 write out (`DSPEngine.attach(_:to:)`); a member the
#            module adds to a type it does not own (`extension Pipeline.gain(_:ramp:isActive:)`); or a module
#            the facade re-exports (`reexport ZTronDSPCore`). Overloads share their name, and so one line.
#   where    the clause that lists it: a section of the specification (`§5.11.1`), a rule or a row it defines
#            (`VC-4`, `WP-204`, `F5`), a row of Appendix A (`App. A row 6`), or a change request
#            (`CR-018 item 11`). Never empty. For CZTronDSP the unit is the header function or type, as
#            §5.11.1 and the rows of M2 name them.
#   note     a few words on what the symbol is there for.
# Lines are sorted by module, then by symbol (byte order). `Scripts/api-digest.sh --check` (check 3) and
# `Scripts/api-digest.sh --spec-map` fail on a public symbol without a line, a line no digest holds, a place
# the specification or Docs/Process/changes does not have, and a line out of order or repeated.
